map.基于生物电阻抗分析法（BIA），通过阻抗指数估算总体水与去脂体重，进而换算体脂率: Based on bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA), estimate total body water and fat-free mass from the impedance index, then derive body-fat percentage.
map.📖 查看「体脂电阻抗估算（BIA 公式）使用指南」: 📖 View the "Body Fat Bioimpedance Estimate (BIA Formula) Guide"
map.阻抗指数 = 身高² / 阻抗 Z；总体水 TBW = 1.20 + 0.45×: Impedance index = height² / impedance Z; total body water TBW = 1.20 + 0.45×index + 0.18×weight; fat-free mass FFM = TBW / 0.732 (capped at 0.95×weight); body fat % = (weight − FFM) / weight × 100
map.生物电阻抗分析法（BIA）：用身高平方与阻抗值算阻抗指数，再按回归式估算总体水，: Bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA): compute the impedance index from height squared and impedance, then estimate total body water from the regression, back out fat-free mass (FFM) using the ~73.2% water fraction of lean tissue, and finally obtain body-fat percentage and fat mass. Results are rated by sex; before measuring, avoid strenuous exercise and heavy water intake to reduce error.
map.💡 Sun 等(2003) BIA：总体水 TBW = 1.20 + 0.45×: 💡 Sun et al. (2003) BIA: total body water TBW = 1.20 + 0.45×(H²/Z) + 0.18×W; fat-free mass FFM = TBW ÷ 0.732.
map.BIA 受水分状态影响大：饮酒、运动、月经、脱水都会改变读数: BIA is strongly affected by hydration status: alcohol, exercise, menstruation and dehydration all change the reading
map.建议晨起空腹排尿后测量，固定时间对比趋势更可靠: Measure on waking after emptying your bladder, fasted; comparing trends at a fixed time is more reliable
map.阻抗越高通常体脂越高（水分导电，脂肪阻抗大）: Higher impedance usually means higher body fat (water conducts, fat has high impedance)
map.本公式为成人群体估算，孕妇、水肿患者不适用: This formula is an estimate for the adult population and does not apply to pregnant women or patients with oedema

map.可复现算例：男 30 岁、175cm、70kg、阻抗 450Ω: Reproducible example: man, 30 years, 175 cm, 70 kg, impedance 450 Ω
map.输入：男、30 岁、身高 175cm、体重 70kg、电阻抗 450Ω。\n阻抗:
Input: male, 30 years, height 175 cm, weight 70 kg, impedance 450 Ω.
Impedance index H²/Z=175²/450=30625/450=68.1 cm²/Ω.
Total body water TBW=1.20+0.45×68.1+0.18×70=1.20+30.6+12.6=44.4 L.
Fat-free mass FFM=TBW/0.732=44.4/0.732=60.7 kg (≤ weight, valid).
Body fat %=(70−60.7)/70×100=13.3%; men <14 → grade athlete.
Fat mass=9.3 kg; water share of body weight=44.4/70×100=63.5%.
Conclusion: this man's body-fat percentage is about 13.3% (athlete level), with FFM 60.7 kg and TBW 44.4 L.
map.BIA 受hydration（喝水/出汗）、饭后、测量时段影响，误差通常 ±3–: BIA is affected by hydration (drinking/sweating), meals and the time of measurement, with an error usually of ±3–5%. Measuring barefoot at a fixed time on waking after emptying the bladder is recommended; this formula is an empirical regression for trend reference only, and medical-grade body fat should be measured by DEXA/underwater weighing.
map.阻抗指数 H²/Z 代表什么？: What does the impedance index H²/Z represent?
map.身高平方除以电阻抗，反映身体导电组织（瘦体水分）多少：指数越高通常瘦体重越多、体: Height squared divided by impedance reflects how much conductive tissue (lean body water) the body has: a higher index usually means more lean mass and lower body fat. It is the core intermediate quantity for converting BIA into TBW and FFM, and the body-fat grading thresholds differ by sex/age.
map.生物电阻抗分析（BIA）利用脂肪与水分导电性差异估算体成分。本工具基于 Sun: Bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA) uses the difference in conductivity between fat and water to estimate body composition. This tool is based on the Sun et al. (2003) formula, estimating total body water and fat-free mass from the impedance index.
